messages.content: ترجم كل وحدة إنجليزية إلى العربية الفصحى بدقة واكتمال، مع حفظ المعنى والأسماء والإشارات الكتابية. لا تضف أسماء أو معلومات غير موجودة في النص، ولا تكتب ملاحظات أو شروحاً. أخرج JSON مطابقاً للمخطط فقط. يجب أن تكون chapter وverse عددين صحيحين بأرقام 0-9، وأن يكون text_ar ترجمة الوحدة وحدها.

{"chapter":4,"verses":[{"chapter":4,"verse":11,"text":"But when I heard it, I gave praise to God and did not blaspheme."},{"chapter":4,"verse":12,"text":"And when the Seducer learned of my fortitude, he plotted new things against me."},{"chapter":4,"verse":13,"text":"He disguised himself as King of Persia and besieged my city, and after he had led off all that were therein, he spoke to them in malice, saying in boastful language:"},{"chapter":4,"verse":14,"text":"\"This man Job who has obtained all the goods of the earth and left nothing for others, he has destroyed and torn down the temple of god."},{"chapter":4,"verse":15,"text":"Therefore shall I repay to him what he has done to the house of the great god."}],"book_code":"TJOB"}

response_format: JSON schema with book_code and verses. Each item has integer chapter, integer verse, and Arabic text_ar. Return exactly source verse numbers 11,12,13,14,15 in this chapter.
